note_sharpe: Sharpe on excess of 3m T-bill; ann = sqrt(12) x monthly
D4_note: hedge effect = monthly overlay return (live funds: hedged ETF minus its unhedged twin). DDWM starts 2016-02 and HEFA 2014-02, so fund rows fall almost entirely in the seen period. Static ratios are never picked from a seen period.
D5_note: Max-Carry equals the v1 rate-signal-only book (hedge when the US 3m rate exceeds the currency's). Baseline, not a test.
D6_note: v1 uses 3m OECD rates for 1m forwards. Bound, not a measurement: extra bp/yr charged on the hedged notional (free forward-point data not available).
D8_construction: Synthetic: foreign government bond = US 10y constant-maturity par-bond total return (FRED DGS10, macro.bond_excess_returns + 3m T-bill) used as the local-currency bond return; USD return = local bond + basket spot move - h x basket forward excess return - overlay cost. No foreign yield curves are free; local-bond/currency correlation is therefore not a measurement of any real bond market. Descriptive only.
